title: MasterClass Online Classes
description: MasterClass offers online classes created for students of all skill levels. Our instructors are the best in the world.
summary: MasterClass offers an extensive online learning platform where users can access over 200 classes taught by renowned experts across a variety of fields including acting, music, cooking, writing, and technology. Membership provides all-access features like audio-only lessons, offline viewing, and new content added monthly. Users can explore trending categories like business, health, and art, and enjoy a 30-day money-back guarantee. MasterClass also provides a certificate program for members to validate their learning. Recent classes focus on attachment theory, relationship reworking, and innovative AI applications. Membership starts at $10/month, billed annually.
